name: Finding and preparing information for the Mind
vision_statement: The information a request needs is found and prepared before the Mind asks for it, from the system's own cards, its files and what comes to mind unasked.
opportunities: How cards are built from files, how the right ones are picked for a request and what comes to mind unasked can each be improved on one measure without changing the Mind.
solution_coherence: This part finds and prepares information before it is asked for. Local File Context makes the files of a working folder usable as context. It builds the cards of the folder through Cards From Files. It chooses which files of the folder a piece of work sees first and which folders are left out through Folder View. Context Retriever picks the cards and file units that bear on the request. Focus Context gathers the notes a person saved about their own named focus, ranks that focus first through the Context Retriever and writes the brief and the one line a session starts with. Intuition offers what occurs to the system unasked. Relevant Solutions names the consumer's ESOI solutions a request concerns, with the scopes above each and the solutions relying on each.
